title: Universal script hub 30 and more features
features:
Box ESP — draws a box around players

Highlight ESP — glows players through walls

Names, distance & health bars

Tracers — lines pointing to players

NPC ESP — box and distance for NPCs

Custom colors for enemies, NPCs and tracers

Aimbot

Player aimbot — hold RMB to lock on

NPC aimbot — hold RMB to lock on NPCs

Silent aim — hits register on target without camera moving

Triggerbot & Delay Slider— auto shoots when crosshair is on target 

Wall check — only targets visible players

FOV circle & FOV lock

Smoothing slider

Aim part selector (Head / Body)

Movement

Fly — WASD + Space/Ctrl to move, adjustable speed

Noclip — walk through walls

Walk speed & jump power sliders with reset button

Desync — raknet must be on

Infinite jump

Spin with speed control

Player

Invisibility

Anti-AFK

Click teleport — click anywhere to teleport

Teleport To Player

Save & teleport to a set location

Fullbright — removes darkness

Remove fog

Utility

Server hop — finds and joins a new server

Spectate — watch any player

Fling

Select a player and fling them


Controls

Right Ctrl — minimize / open the GUI

RMB (hold) — activate aimbot
